title: Weapon on top of actor sprite

posts.author: chrismumu
posts.body: In side view battle, MZ is displaying the weapon of the actor below the actor sprite, so it looks weird when the actor is wielding a long rifle type weapon, half of the gun is hidden behind the actor. Please help me find a way to display the weapon above the actor instead. I am using most Visustella plugins such as core, battle core, weapon animation and more. Thank you.

Thanks so much! I'm also using the visustella weapon swap plugin, so each character of mine is using two weapons that they can swap between, including the big gun wielder. How should I set the attack skill if my actor has the possibility of wielding two different weapon types?
Click to expand...
If you don't get the plugin working (VisuStella changes those functions), you can make your attack skill action sequence check if the user has certain weapon type and make conditional branches.
Like conditional script (replace X with weapon type Id):
BattleManager._subject.isWtypeEquipped(X)
Or you can just give your weapons the trait to change attack skill, instead of the actor.

Event command show picture. Or make (MV style) animation and show it.
I think you can get coordinates for the pictures (these scripts in control variable and show pic at the variable x,y coordinates):
BattleManager._subject.battler().x
BattleManager._subject.battler().y
You may need to add/subtract to the variables (with control variables event command) a bit to position the weapon correctly.
